# cursor-hindsight-ondemand

> On-demand local Hindsight memory daemon for Cursor on Windows.

This project starts `hindsight-embed` only when a Cursor agent session or MCP tools need memory — not at Windows logon. Traffic stays on `http://127.0.0.1:9077` so a cold start does not fall through to Hindsight Cloud.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand#readme): install, how it works, FAQ
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand/blob/main/NOTICE): third-party attributions

## Upstream

- Hindsight: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight
- Cursor: https://cursor.com

## Not included

GitNexus and other code-graph tools are out of scope. This repo only covers on-demand Hindsight lifecycle wrappers for Cursor.
